description: No automerge for I hate money's own version, not even at the patch level: the app runs flask_migrate's `upgrade()` against the operator's database on every start (ihatemoney/run.py, 'auto-execute migrations on runtime'), and patch releases do add migrations - 7.0.1 introduced 06884b17c50f_fix_password_hash_length.
A bumped image would therefore rewrite a live schema, forward-only, before anyone looked at the update; Molecule installs from scratch and structurally cannot see that risk.
